sentences.en: The anthropologist says odd customs do persist in the region.
sentences.zh: 这位人类学家说，在该地区仍存在一些奇怪的风俗。

sentences.en: Yoshio persisted in believing that in spite of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 尽管有证据表明相反，吉秀夫坚持认为这一点。

sentences.en: You should persist in your efforts to learn English.
sentences.zh: 你应该坚持不懈地努力学习英语。
